title: KiriNoMichi (霧の道)
description: KiriNoMichi (霧の道) – A sleek Velocity plugin for seamless server switching and GUI-based teleportation across your network.
body:
**KiriNoMichi (霧の道) is a sleek, high-performance server selector and teleportation plugin for Velocity.
Built for modern Minecraft networks, it lets players jump between servers with style — using commands or a beautiful GUI — with lightning-fast response.**

✦ Features:
🌀 /server command for instant switching

🏯 GUI-based selector (requires Bukkit backend plugin)

🔄 Auto-detects servers on the proxy

🔐 Permission-based access control

💨 Zero-lag server transitions

💬 Optional cross-server chat & messages

“The path through the mist connects more than just servers... it connects legends.”

⚠️ This plugin is for Velocity Proxy only. Download Velocity here: papermc.io/downloads/velocity
